COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C482 No. 1147 of 2023
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate, for the 
applicants. 
Mr. Sachin Panwar and Mrs. Lata Negi, Brief 
Holders, for the State of Uttarakhand. 
This C482 Application arises out of the 
complaint proceedings drawn by the 
complainant/respondent which was emanating from 
the matrimonial discord. Subsequent to the 
registration of the complaint on 18th June, 2022, the 
cognizance order has been issued on 3rd January, 
2023, whereby, the applicants have been tried for 
the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 
506 of the IPC. 
Being a matrimonial dispute, which is 
exclusively a private in nature, there is always 
possibility of making an effort for mediation. 
In order to explore the possibility of 
mediation, let notices be issued to respondent No.2. 
Steps to serve respondent No.2 would be 
taken by the applicants within a week from today. 
List after service on notice on the 
respondents, to enable the parties to appear in the 
mediation proceedings. 
Till the next date of listing, the proceedings 
of Compliant Case No. 3651 of 2022, Savita Rani  alias Sheetal Vs. Abhinav Verma and others, 
pending consideration before the Court of Addl. 
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar, would be permitted to be 
adjourned on the request of the learned counsel for 
the applicants. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 14.06.2023
Shiv
